english.note: Use this for the personal closeness or depth of the relationship between particular people.
Choose this for personal rapport based on familiarity, trust, or an established friendship rather than mainly professional cooperation.
Use this when the focus is on the degree of personal relationship, especially when saying it is not very deep.

examples.english: I have a deep friendship with Ming.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 aa3 ming4 gaau1 cing4 hou2 sam1

examples.english: I have a deep rapport with Old Chan, and we always help each other out.
examples.traditional: 我同老陳識咗好多年，大家交情深，有咩事都會互相幫手。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 lou5 can4 sik1 zo2 hou2 do1 nin4 daai6 gaa1 gaau1 cing4 sam1 jau5 me1 si6 dou1 wui6 wu6 soeng1 bong1 sau2

examples.english: We have only a slight acquaintance; we used to be colleagues.
examples.traditional: 我同佢得少少交情，係以前同事。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 dak1 siu2 siu2 gaau1 cing4 hai6 ji5 cin4 tung4 si6
